meta.interpretation: Counted trials for each of Semaglutide vs Tirzepatide, grouped by trial phase.

visualization_rationale.reason: A grouped bar chart effectively compares the distribution of trial phases between semaglutide and tirzepatide trials side by side.

assumptions: Each cohort is a separate search; a trial matching more than one cohort is counted in each.

Trials registered with two phases (e.g. Phase 1/Phase 2) are counted once, in a combined bucket. 'Not Applicable' (an explicit NA, typical of non-drug studies) and 'Not specified' (no phase recorded) are kept separate.
